conventions.units: SVG user units on a 1024x1024 viewBox; pixel column i spans [i,i+1] so its centre is i+0.5
conventions.note_vs_stage1: stage1 quoted centre-lines in pixel-INDEX space; add +0.5 to convert to SVG user units. All numbers in this file are SVG user units.
conventions.method: opaque-bar-over-two-backgrounds cross-section model, v(t)=bg_o*(1-S(t-eo))+A*(S(t-eo)-S(t-ei))+bg_i*S(t-ei), S = unit step convolved with a 1px box and a Gaussian(sigma); fitted by least squares per scan line. Estimator verified exact (<1e-5 px) on analytic exact-area bars at many widths and sub-pixel phases.

stroke_width.note: per-edge spread 6.05-6.25 px; measurement is exact on synthetic bars, so the spread is a property of the reference (JPEG ringing + possible resampling), not of the estimator. Corners measured 6.16-6.39 with an interpolated normal scan whose companion straight-edge values were 6.14-6.31, i.e. no corner/edge width difference beyond 0.05 px.

corner_summary.verdict: NOT a plain circular-arc SVG rounded rect. Curvature varies smoothly along each corner (local radius ~250-400 px near the straights, ~160-165 px through the 45-degree region), i.e. a continuous-curvature / "corner-smoothed" (squircle-style) corner. All four corners are the same.
corner_summary.local_curvature_radius_profile: ends ~250-400 px (sliding 12-deg window, inflated by the straight run), middle 45 deg +-20 deg: 145-175 px, mean 160; see corner_outline_points to re-fit

gradient.note: stop colours are the ABSOLUTE measured opaque-stroke sRGB colour (model2 A), so paint the stroke with stop-opacity 1. offset = u/575 with u = hypot(x-cx,(y-cy)/q). Only offsets 0.68-1.0 are constrained by the perimeter; inside that the gradient is unconstrained by the frame.

hue.verdict: B~=G at every station; the R deficit shrinks monotonically as the stroke brightens (R/G 0.71 at the dim corners -> 0.95 at the bright top-edge middle). So the stroke is NOT one colour at varying alpha: the gradient needs colour stops going from cyan-ish at the corners to near-neutral/white at the edge midpoints. Not explained by sRGB-vs-linear compositing (checked: in linear light B/G stays 1.12 but R/G still moves 0.53 -> 0.85).

model_residuals_rms_of_stroke_luminance.units: sRGB code values; the stroke amplitude itself ranges 20-114

background_at_stroke_boundary.note: extrapolated to the stroke boundary by the cross-section model, so free of stroke spill. Far-field (10-20 px) exterior is rgb(~0.4,~1.4,~2-7); the interior field keeps rising inward.

layering.verdict: single stroke. No second ring, bevel or outer glow above ~1.5% of the stroke value.
layering.residual_structure: after the opaque-bar model, the stacked residual (fraction of the stroke value) is an oscillation confined to |t|<5 px: about -0.02 at |t|~2 inside the stroke, +0.03..+0.06 at |t|~1, -0.05..-0.08 at t=+2, +0.01..+0.04 at t=+4 (just inside the inner edge), and |resid|<0.012 for |t|>6. Sign pattern is undershoot-then-overshoot around each edge = JPEG/sharpening ringing; do not model it.
layering.plateau_flatness: the stroke plateau is flat to +-5%; the single brightest pixel of the cross-section is always the one just inside the INNER boundary (+5..+7% over the plateau mean) on all four edges, with the pixel just inside the OUTER boundary +3..+5%. Symmetric double overshoot => ringing, not a designed inner hairline.
layering.faint_outer_tail: exterior luminance rises from the far-field level by +0.5 to +1.3 code values over the 4-6 px immediately outside the stroke (1-2% of the stroke value); the interior dips 2.4-2.5 code values 1 px inside the stroke and overshoots +2 at 2 px. Both are at the ringing level.

renderer_caveat.resvg: resvg/tiny-skia snaps stroke outline edges to multiples of 0.25 px. Verified: a flat-stroke render of this frame at stroke-width 6.130 measured 6.002/6.255/6.248/6.253 on L/R/T/B with all eight edges landing exactly on 0.25 multiples. So do not tune geometry below ~0.13 px against resvg.
renderer_caveat.chromium: got the two vertical edges right (6.122/6.126) but snapped the horizontal ones the same way (6.246).
renderer_caveat.implication: measured-vs-rendered residuals of up to 0.13 px in edge position/width are renderer quantisation, not model error.

recommended_path.construction: per corner: straight -> arc(r=639.1, turn 5.24 deg) -> arc(r=163.56, turn 79.52 deg) -> arc(r=639.1, turn 5.24 deg) -> straight; all three arcs sweep the same way, so in SVG they are three A commands with the same sweep flag.

corner_outline_points.note: sub-pixel stroke centre-line points from axis-aligned row/column cuts (no interpolation); method validated to 0.05 px rms and <0.04 px bias on a synthetic rounded rect

perimeter_photometry.note: every ~8 px of arc length; S* = absolute opaque-stroke sRGB value from the cross-section model; bo*/bi* = background extrapolated to the outer/inner stroke boundary
